description: ARCA Puglia Centrale publishes annual registers of property it owns in its role managing public and social housing in Puglia. The 2024 and 2025 publications share the same publisher, named property-register series and four-field schema, so they are retained as annual views of one resource. The fields are Codice Immobile, Tipo di diritto, %, and Destinazione d'uso. The percentage field has no further definition in the inspected metadata. The schema supplies property codes, rights categories and intended use; it does not provide addresses, coordinates, floor areas, condition, occupancy or dwelling counts. Annual snapshots may overlap and must not be summed as distinct assets. The stated years label publications; individual observation dates remain unverified. Both native records declare CSV distributions under the CC BY 4.0 licence. Metadata are public, while later file-use charges and current completeness are unknown. No specific simulation application or exact related catalogue resource is established. No property rows or file bodies were read.
